basis: Estimate, not a quote. Per run: half of the case max_turns are used (at least 8); the context starts at 15k tokens and grows 1.5k per turn, read from the prompt cache at USD 0.30 per million; 1.5k fresh tokens per turn written to the cache at USD 3.75 per million; 600 output tokens per turn at USD 15 per million (Sonnet-class prices, to be checked against the current price list before approval); x1.3 when the case allows the Agent tool; each llm grader adds 3 judge calls of about 8k input and 150 output tokens at haiku-class prices. Both environments pin --model sonnet and --judge-model haiku. Compare the first lot's real cost with the estimate and correct the constants in run.py before approving the next lot.
comparison: v0.3 x v0.2.0, both with the plugin, 3 runs per arm. A new case passes when v0.3 passes 2 of 3 and is above v0.2.0. An existing case does not regress when v0.3 is not more than 1 run below v0.2.0.
